messages:
maria_partnerships: kickoff for marketplace staging handoff. Need quick alignment on telemetry webhook, publisher roles, and trial visibility for AWS/GCP/Azure. Who can own what?

sam_engineer: I can take the webhook. Question: oauth client vs shared secret/HMAC? Also need payload schema for installs/activations.

tina_pm: HMAC is fine for staging, add retry semantics and idempotency keys. We'll need events: install, activate_trial, convert_to_paid, uninstall. Keep payload small.

leo_legal: Heads up: marketplace listing needs explicit telemetry consent + opt-out link. EU users require data residency note and KMS mention. I will provide exact wording.

alex_ops: For AWS we require a cross-account role from publisher account into our staging. I'll draft an assume-role policy and a minimal policy for S3/KMS access (if they provide logs). For GCP it'll be service account impersonation and for Azure a managed identity + role assignment.

sam_engineer: sample HMAC spec I propose:

```
POST /marketplace/webhook
Headers:
  X-Redwood-Signature: sha256=HEX(HMAC_SHA256(secret, body))
  X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>
```

Body example: {"event":"install","sku":"trial-30","customer_id":"cust_123","timestamp":1706123456}

Add retry/backoff: 3 attempts, exponential backoff starting 1s.

alex_ops: preview IAM trust policy (AWS):

```
{
  \"Version\": \"2012-10-17\",
  \"Statement\": [
    {
      \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
      \"Principal\": {\"AWS\": \"arn:aws:iam::PUBLISHER_ACCOUNT_ID:role/MarketplacePublisher\"},
      \"Action\": \"sts:AssumeRole\"
    }
  ]
}
```

And minimal inline policy to allow S3 PutObject to a shard prefix and KMS:Decrypt for logs ingestion. I'll add Terraform snippet soon.

maria_partnerships: action list: sam implement webhook + tests, alex create role + terraform, tina update runbook with per-cloud steps, leo add consent text and retention limits. Aim to have everything reviewed by Monday EOD so we can request listing window Tuesday morning PT.

infra-bot: CI: marketplace-webhook-staging build passed (build-82). Health endpoint https://staging-api.redwood.ai/marketplace/webhook/health -> 200 OK.

sam_engineer: I'll also add middleware to drop duplicate events (check idempotency key) and surface failed delivery counts to the console. ETA Monday midday.

leo_legal: Uploaded consent blurb to Drive: \"By enabling this integration you agree to telemetry collection for usage metrics. You may opt-out at any time via https://support.redwood.ai/marketplace-optout. Data for EU customers will be stored in EU regions and encrypted with customer KMS where applicable.\" Please review.

alex_ops: Terraform snippet (preview) posted to repo in PR #122: includes aws_iam_role and trust policy. Publisher needs to attach role/role-arn to their listing.

tina_pm: Updated runbook checklist: AWS (IAM role + role ARN), GCP (service account + keyless impersonation guide), Azure (managed identity flow + role assignment). Also telemetry schema and example curl tests.

maria_partnerships: Great. Once legal signoff + role ARNs + webhook integration tests green we schedule publish request with each marketplace. Tentative slot: Tuesday 09:00 PT.

sam_engineer: Noted. Will ping here when tests green.

maria_partnerships: Thanks all 680
